description: This file defines a PHP class Image_Graph_Marker_Star, which extends the Image_Graph_Marker class to render a star-shaped marker on a canvas as part of a graph plotting library. It includes methods for drawing the star shape at specified coordinates and references external files/classes.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Star
classes.description: A class that renders a star-shaped marker for graph plotting, extending the Image_Graph_Marker base class.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a star shape at given (x, y) coordinates on the canvas, with optional data values influencing appearance.
